summary_md: **Fahad Saleem ([@Pakgowithai](https://x.com/Pakgowithai/status/2116045045468131468))** describes **claude-mem**, which logs what an agent did, compresses it into short notes and feeds back only what the next task needs, for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini ([thedotmack/claude-mem](https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem)).
